subject: Quick nudge for the missing pack
text:
Hi there,

Hope you had a decent weekend. Sorry to nudge you so soon, but it has been about two days since I sent over the note, and I am still stuck on the missing file. The onboarding pack I mentioned would be a real lifesaver today, because my team is ready to compare quotes and cannot move forward without seeing the full terms.

If the document is sitting in someone's queue, could you ping them and attach a quick copy here? No need to polish it up, just the working version is fine. If it lives on a shared drive, a link would do too. I know everyone is juggling lots of plates, so I appreciate you helping me unblock this. Once I get it, I will reply straight away and confirm everything looks okay. Thanks loads for your patience, and let me know if there is a better person to chase. Also, if there was a snag with access permissions or an approval step, tell me and I can chase my side, because I do not want this hanging around. Fingers crossed we can sort it this afternoon.
